tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background and the app shell (nav rail, tab bar). From the brief.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tiles, inputs, dialogs. From the brief.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for rows, nav items and quiet buttons. Derived; ink, muted and every status colour keep at least 5.4:1 on it in both themes.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between rows and inside panels only. Derived. Too faint for control borders; use line-strong there.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons, chart tracks. Derived; at least 3.5:1 on bg, surface and surface-hover in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg, surface, surface-hover and every -soft tint. 14:1 or better in both themes (AAA). From the brief.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, hints, client names under task titles. On bg, surface and surface-hover: 7.1:1 or better in both themes (AAA). From the brief.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Primary buttons, links, current nav item, selected chips, chart bars, the focus ring. As text on bg, surface or accent-soft: 5.5:1 or better. From the brief.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind accent text: current nav item, info pills, selected rows. Derived.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any solid accent, good, warning or critical fill (primary button, overdue pill, reminder banner). 6.6:1 or better on all four in both themes. Never use literal white: the dark theme needs dark text on its light fills.

tokens.name: good
tokens.usage: Done, Paid, In credit. Always with a check icon or the word. As text on bg, surface or good-soft: 5.4:1 or better. From the brief.

tokens.name: good-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind good text in pills. Derived.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Due today, Part-paid, Later today. Always with a clock icon or the word. As text on bg, surface or warning-soft: 5.6:1 or better. From the brief.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning text in pills. Derived.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Overdue, reminders due, destructive actions, field errors. Always with an alert icon or the word. As text on bg, surface or critical-soft: 5.8:1 or better; as a fill under on-fill: 7.1:1 or better. From the brief.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Tint behind critical text: the confirm step of a destructive action, error summaries. Derived.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour: 3px solid outline, 2px offset. Alias of accent, so a theme that moves accent moves focus. 5.5:1 or better on every ground.

tokens.name: chart-bar
tokens.usage: Bars in the Next 14 days chart and Open work by client. Alias of accent.

tokens.name: chart-track
tokens.usage: Empty track behind a horizontal bar. Alias of line; the value is always printed as a number beside it.

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Bricolage Grotesque, hosted on Google Fonts. Headings and big numbers only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: One per screen: the page title in the header.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel titles and client names on a client page.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Group headings inside a panel: Due now, Later today, Upcoming.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The number on a dashboard tile. Tabular figures.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible, hosted on Google Fonts. 18px base; nothing in the app is smaller than 16px.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Send the Bayside Dental quote before Friday.
styles.usage: All running text, input values, notes.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Task and reminder titles, button labels, nav labels on desktop.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, pill text, tile labels, tab-bar labels.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, hints, chart axis labels. The floor: never go below this.

spacing.note: 4px base. Lay out with gap, not margins.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside pills, icon nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked rows in a list; label to input.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding on phones; the minimum side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding on desktop; between panels.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between page sections; header to content.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top of an empty state.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, chips, chart bars.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items, tiles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels and the reminder banner.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, switches, count badges.

shadow.note: One elevation. In dark, separation comes from a 1px border instead.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: Panels and dashboard tiles.

size.note: Fixed sizes that carry accessibility rules.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tap target in either dimension, for every control.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs, selects and nav items.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Desktop navigation rail, at 900px viewport width and up.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Phone tab bar, below 900px. Add the bottom safe-area inset.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the main column.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for notes and long text.
